title: Symrise expands global production platform for sustainable musk fragrance ingredient
summary: – Investment in world-scale capacity expansion in India for Globalide® to strengthen global supply – Sustainable macrocyclic musk fragrance ingredient supports customers in developing future-ready fragrance formulations – Globalide® strengthens portfolio of differentiated specialties and supports ONE Symrise strategy
